turns.text: Keep my guitar exactly as I played it, whatever else changes.
Bring the verse strings in two bars later.
Go with the third strings option in the chorus.
Put the brass back in, I want to hear it.
The verse strings should only hear the piano.
Turn the second vocal down 3 dB.
The downbeat of bar 17 is at 78.9 seconds, not where you put it.
Let the chorus strings finish at the end of bar 38 instead of running to the end.
